entries.text: Tracker created and seeded with initial research for 9 schools. Most dates are last cycle's (carried_from_2026) — the first refresh will confirm 2027 dates as schools publish them (Aug–Oct 2026).

Marymount/Northeastern (since removed from the list) — Added Marymount → Northeastern University – New York City. The MMC/Northeastern merger completed July 9–10, 2026; the dance BFA continues as a 4-year NYC program, but application/audition mechanics are mid-transition — watch nyc.northeastern.edu.

Fordham/Ailey: confirmed both apps (Fordham Common App + Ailey dance application) share one Nov 1, 2026 deadline for Fall 2027; added the $45 audition fee and recommendation/essay/interview details from the Ailey apply page. Fordham.edu itself remains bot-blocked (CAS login loop) — test policy, tuition, and FAFSA/CSS codes still need a manual browser check.

NYU Tisch: confirmed ED1/ED2/RD deadlines for Fall 2027 and corrected the prescreen-materials due dates, which run a few days after the academic deadline (ED1 Nov 2, ED2 Jan 4, RD Jan 18). Callback audition dates are now published: ED1 Nov 13, ED2 Jan 19, RD Jan 30–Feb 6, 2027.

Pace/Sands: confirmed ED and final-deadline dates for Fall 2027 on Pace's Key Dates page; added decision-release dates (ED Dec 1, final Mar 31), the $90 audition fee, FAFSA priority (Nov 15 for ED), the incoming cohort size (34/yr), and affiliated companies. Acceptd remains the confirmed portal.

SUNY Purchase: Fall 2027 audition dates are now published — on-campus auditions Feb 6/12/20/26, 2027, with a Feb 1 application deadline and Feb 8 portfolio-submission deadline. Cost estimates updated to 2026-27 figures. Still unresolved: whether a non-international applicant can request a video audition — the page's alternate-arrangement language remains scoped to international applicants only; an email to dance@purchase.edu is still needed to confirm.

Marymount/Northeastern (since removed from the list): the entire legacy mmm.edu domain now redirects to nyc.northeastern.edu, which still has no dedicated dance-audition page — audition mechanics (portal, prescreen, digital-audition survival) remain unpublished post-merger. EA decision-release date updated to Feb 15, 2027. An unconfirmed lead (an Acceptd portal at app.getacceptd.com/mmm with Jan 10 & Feb 7, 2027 virtual-audition dates) surfaced via search but could not be verified directly — bot-blocked on fetch — and needs a human browser check before it's trusted.

USC Kaufman: the Portfolio and FAQ pages still explicitly reference the Fall 2026 / 2025-26 cycle — Fall 2027 materials aren't posted yet, so deadlines stay carried_from_2026. Filled in previously-unknown facts: recommendation letters are not accepted or considered, USC merit scholarship terms (Trustee/Presidential/Deans tiers, no separate app), tuition ($73,260/yr), and cost of attendance (~$99,139/yr on/off-campus).

Chapman: CSS Profile is now required for financial aid (previously recorded as not required) — CSS code 4047, priority Nov 15, 2026 for EA/ED I. All four EA/ED1/ED2/RD academic deadlines were reconfirmed for Fall 2027.

Chapman: corrected the Creative Supplement deadline — it's due 5 days after the application deadline, not the same day (EA/ED I → Nov 6, 2026; ED II/RD → Jan 20, 2027). Tuition updated to the 2026-27 rate (~$70,394).

Arizona: Fall 2027 audition calendar confirmed — the Arizona Jazz Dance Showcase moved to Oct 9, 2026 (previously carried from Sept 18; registration closes Oct 2, capacity 100), a new Sept 26, 2026 on-campus date was added, and the January on-campus date is confirmed for Jan 23, 2027.

Arizona: clarified the first-year Dance Merit Scholarship gate — it requires the APPLICATION (not the audition) by the Nov 1 EA deadline, regardless of audition date; the audition itself can still happen later in person, but video-only auditioners remain ineligible in year 1. Cost of attendance updated to 2026-27 figures (~$67,770 on-campus / ~$63,100 off-campus, non-resident).

Boston Conservatory: the previously bot-blocked audition-requirements and deadlines pages are now accessible. Filled in EA/RA decision-release dates (Jan 31 / Apr 1, 2027), identified the audition portal as SlideRoom, added the $75/$150 tiered application fee, and published audition dates — Nov 14, 2026 on-campus (Contemporary + Commercial) as part of a 10-city tour, plus a live-online option Dec 5, 2026 (RA: Feb 13, 2027). Tuition/COA updated to 2026-27 published rates (~$55,120 tuition; ~$87,817 total COA).

Arizona: new for Fall 2027 — the base UA admission application has moved to the Common App (previously UA's own application). The Future Wildcat portal remains the destination for the College of Fine Arts / dance video-audition supplement only. All previously confirmed audition dates and fees were re-verified unchanged.

Pace/Sands: prescreen video-spec wording refined — the two required photos are specifically "first arabesque en l'air" plus a pose of the applicant's choosing (not two arabesque photos as previously recorded), and a headshot + resume are itemized alongside it. All Fall 2027 Key Dates deadlines re-confirmed unchanged.

USC Kaufman: the Portfolio page has been taken down and now shows only a "Check back soon" placeholder — the Fall 2026 content it carried since last cycle is gone and Fall 2027 details haven't appeared yet. All Kaufman deadline/portfolio facts are temporarily unverifiable at the source; re-check closer to the Dec 1 deadline.

Boston Conservatory: clarified that the brief post-solo faculty conversation happens for both the Contemporary Dance Performance and Commercial Dance auditions, not just Commercial as previously recorded. All EA/RA deadlines re-confirmed unchanged.

Removed Marymount/Northeastern from the tracked list at the family's request. Its audition mechanics were never published after the Marymount Manhattan / Northeastern merger, and no checklist work had been started. Historical changelog entries are kept but no longer point at the school id.

Added Loyola Marymount University (Los Angeles). NOTE: LMU awards a BA in Dance across three tracks (Dance; Dance Pedagogy & Social Action; Dance Choreography & Performance) - it is the only non-BFA program on this list. Audition is video-only via Slate after applying: a 3-minute video introduction plus a 2-minute solo (no compilations). Published deadlines recorded as ED I / EA Nov 1, ED II Jan 8, RD Jan 15 with decisions rolling by Apr 1; FAFSA by Nov 1 (ED I), Jan 10 (EA and ED II) or Feb 1 (general). All LMU facts are search-sourced and marked carried_from_2026 or tbd - this session could not reach lmu.edu directly, so the weekly refresh will verify them.

USC Kaufman: the Portfolio page is live again (was a "Check back soon" placeholder as of 2026-08-17) with real content, including live-audition dates for the first time this cycle (Jan 16-17, 2027, one day per applicant) and a selection-notification date (by Dec 18, 2026). Also updated wording for the resume (now notes standardized-test info) and the 250-word short-answer prompt (now asks about the applicant's role within their training community, not academic/interdisciplinary opportunities). The Dec 1 application/portfolio deadline itself wasn't restated on this pass and is left unchanged. Page still doesn't explicitly say "Fall 2027," so all facts stay at carried_from_2026.

LMU: this runner could reach lmu.edu directly (unlike the session that added the school), so most search-sourced LMU facts are now confirmed off the live pages. Corrections: submission portal is the "LMU Application Status Portal," not Slate; Regular Decision releases "Early March," not Apr 1. Newly filled in: test-optional policy, one required recommendation letter, no interview ("entire audition... submitted online"), decision-release windows for all four rounds, genre emphasis (ballet/contemporary/hip-hop/jazz), a Bill T. Jones/Arnie Zane Company educational partnership, and exact BA track names. The financial-aid page itself is still on the 2025-26/Fall-2026 FAFSA cycle (not yet refreshed for 2027-28) — those deadlines remain projected estimates.
